write_policy.rule: All non-production AgentOS development must explicitly target the integration branch or a declared short-lived child branch. Never omit branch on GitHub write operations.

current_findings: Oracle host instance-20260129-0852 is registered and online as a GitHub self-hosted runner using service account agentos-node.
GitHub -> Oracle machine execution loop has been proven by committed runner evidence.

Branch consolidation is complete logically: feature/distributed-agentos-runtime is the sole canonical vNext continuation line; historical child branches are retired continuation targets.
